title: digital-estate/1
description: Digital accounts, devices and the digital executor. Owner: living. LifeOS stores POINTERS, never secrets.

pointer.description: A LOCATION, never a secret: '1Password/Personal/FNB Online'. Rejects anything shaped like a credential being ASSIGNED a value ('password: hunter2', 'API_KEY=sk-...', 'seed phrase is ...') or a key blob, while still permitting the word 'password' in an ordinary location — '1Password' is the name of the very manager these pointers point at, so a blanket ban on the word would forbid the primary use case. Written with explicit character classes because JSON Schema patterns are ECMA-262, which has no inline (?i) flag. This is a coarse net; pii-guard and the agent charters are the real controls.
